metadata.title: Maryland DNR Deep Research - Hunting Intelligence
metadata.scope: Granular, hunting-specific data from Maryland DNR official sources

wma_parking_and_access.description: Public parking locations, GPS coordinates, hours, and seasonal restrictions

mckee_beshers.name: McKee-Beshers Wildlife Management Area
mckee_beshers.location: River Road near Poolesville, Montgomery County
mckee_beshers.parking: Multiple parking areas (specific GPS coordinates not publicly listed)
seasonal_restrictions: Dogs must be leashed April 15 - August 15 (except in designated dog training areas)
Field trials permitted August 15 through early muzzleloader season and March 1 through April 15
mckee_beshers.hunting_allowed: Monday through Saturday, year-round. No Sunday hunting.

dog_training.status: Designated dog training area, dog training pond, and field trial area available
dog_training.permit: Retriever Dog Training Permit required if releasing live birds (annual fee $5.00)

myrtle_grove.name: Myrtle Grove Wildlife Management Area
myrtle_grove.location: 5625 Myrtle Grove Road, La Plata, Maryland 20646 (Charles County, 5 miles west of La Plata on MD 225)
myrtle_grove.directions: Take U.S. Route 301 south to MD 225
parking_areas: Pomfret Tract at 7434 Bumpy Oak Road
myrtle_grove.habitat: Mature uplands and bottomland forests (oaks, hickories, maples, sycamores, poplars, beech). Includes ~31 acres food plots and 2 greentree reservoirs for waterfowl.
myrtle_grove.hunting_allowed: Monday through Saturday, year-round. No Sunday hunting.
special_rules: Dogs must be leashed April 15 - August 15

area_1.location: South side of Sudlersville Road (MD Route 300), just south of intersection with Emily's Lane
area_1.description: Narrow turn-around at gated end of lane

seasonal_restrictions.sunday_only_access: Some areas restrict non-hunting access to Sundays only September-January and during spring turkey season (Strider WMA, Hugg-Thomas WMA)
seasonal_restrictions.locked_gates: Some parking areas have locked gates. Gate codes provided with parking pass. Lock gates behind you.
seasonal_restrictions.seasonal_closure: Some tracts may have locked gates during off-season (e.g., James Run Tract gate locked except during deer firearms seasons)

gate_and_access_information.cwma_note: Cooperative Wildlife Management Areas may have restricted access times. Contact appropriate DNR office.

shooting_ranges.description: Maryland DNR shooting ranges with hours, fees, and allowed shooting types

state_forest_ranges.name: Elk Neck State Forest Shooting Range
state_forest_ranges.status: Rifle and shotgun ranges closed for safety repairs. Pistol and archery ranges remain open.
state_forest_ranges.permit: Permits available at Maintenance Complex near Main Entrance. Must obtain permit before using range.

state_forest_ranges.name: Savage River State Forest Shooting Range
Green Ridge State Forest Shooting Range

managed_hunts.description: Controlled/managed hunts with lottery systems, permit requirements, and applications

locations: Patapsco Valley State Park and Morgan Run NEA
requirements: Hunter Education and Safety Requirement verification

seneca_creek_state_park.name: Seneca Creek State Park Managed Hunt

wye_island_nrma.name: Wye Island Natural Resources Management Area

hunts.requirements: Sign in and out at Hunter Check In bulletin board on first-come, first-served basis

shooter_qualification.requirement: Proficiency test required for certain managed deer hunts
shooter_qualification.2025_sessions: More than 20 sessions at 10 locations across the state

harvest_reporting.description: Deer harvest reporting requirements, methods, and current systems

current_system.reporting_requirement: All harvested deer must be reported to Maryland DNR
current_system.timeline: Report within 24 hours of taking deer into possession
current_system.prerequisite: Must report BEFORE head or hide is removed
methods: Online registration via Maryland DNR website
Other methods as designated by Department
current_system.confirmation: Confirmation number provided after reporting. Record in ink on big game harvest record or keep as electronic record.

harvest_reporting.historical_note: Maryland previously used physical check station system through 2004 deer hunting season. Current system is internet and phone-based.

dog_training_areas.description: Designated WMA dog training areas with permits and seasonal restrictions

mckee_beshers_wma.permit: Retriever Dog Training Permit required if releasing live birds (annual fee $5.00)

retriever_dog_training_permit.requirement: Required when releasing live birds at designated dog training areas
retriever_dog_training_permit.purpose: Allows training of retriever dogs on state property

general_rules.non_designated_areas: Must obtain permission from land manager before training dogs on state-owned or controlled properties

accessible_hunting.description: ADA accessible hunting blinds, permits, and facilities for hunters with mobility impairments

permits_required.name: Universal Disability Pass
permits_required.application: Available through Wildlife & Heritage Service Offices or online

permits_required.name: Access Permit
permits_required.purpose: Required to utilize accessible hunting accommodations

lecompte_wma.availability: One day per week by reservation

cunningham_swamp_wma.feature: Wheelchair-accessible boardwalk and covered hunting platform

mt_nebo_wma.feature: One mile of special access with accessible covered hunting structure

vehicle_hunting_rules.requirement: Vehicle must be at a complete stop with motor turned off while shooting, aiming, or firing weapon
safety_rules: Weapons must remain unloaded while vehicle is in motion
Loaded weapons cannot be in vehicles on public roadways

accessible_hunting.additional_info: For comprehensive accessible hunting locations and amenities, consult Public Hunting Lands or Access for All website

hunter_education.description: Hunter education courses, online options, field day workshops, and apprentice licensing

course_options.duration: Includes online portion + single day field workshop
course_options.testing: Test required during both online and field day portions
requirements: Behave in mature and safe manner
Make legal, safe, and ethical hunting decisions

apprentice_license.name: Apprentice License
apprentice_license.online_requirement: Short online hunter safety course required prior to purchase
apprentice_license.hunting_requirement: Must hunt with resident 18+ years old with valid non-apprentice hunting license

mentored_hunting.description: Mentored hunt programs pairing experienced hunters with beginners and lapsed hunters

program_flow.step_1: Mentee selected and paired with experienced mentor
program_flow.step_2: Mentor and mentee can communicate via in-person meetings, text, call, or email
program_flow.step_3: Pair participates in technical lectures on firearm safety, hunting tips, techniques, and strategies
program_flow.step_4: Participants receive range time to begin hunting journey

mentored_hunting.special_hunts: Special mentored pheasant hunts available on various Wildlife Management Areas throughout the state

free_public_hunting_permit.description: Requirements and application process for Free Public Hunting Permit program
free_public_hunting_permit.requirement: Required for all designated public hunting sites on state lands
free_public_hunting_permit.prerequisite: Must have valid Hunting License (can obtain permit simultaneously)

obtaining_permit.timeline: Permit will print as product on hunting license

permit_delivery.timeline: Within one business day of online application
permit_delivery.contents: Email with regulation packets and parking pass
permit_delivery.next_steps: Print and fill out parking pass. DNR ID becomes permit.

rules_and_regulations: No permanent tree stands or blinds allowed
All portable tree stands/blinds must be removed at end of day
No placing or hunting over bait
Must display parking permit on vehicle dash
Gates must be locked behind you (code provided with permit)

documents.title: How to Obtain Free Public Hunting Permit Online

nuisance_wildlife_permits.description: Permits for dealing with deer damage, depredation, and other wildlife conflicts

deer_management_permit.purpose: Helps landowners/farmers resolve damage to agricultural crops, orchards, nurseries, managed forests
eligibility_criteria: Must have sustained severe deer damage
Must have economic loss to commercial agricultural property
Property types: row crops, truck crops, pasture, orchard, nursery, Christmas trees

wildlife_damage_control_permit.requirement: Required for any wildlife species (except exempt species)
wildlife_damage_control_permit.purpose: Allows landowner to address wildlife problems

depredation_permits.notes: Available for various wildlife species causing damage

application.process: Schedule wildlife permit appointment by phone or email

hunting_seasons.description: Key Maryland hunting season dates and regulations

archery.dates: September through October + December through January (specific dates vary by region)

small_game.sunday_hunting: All Sundays during open seasons with certain restrictions
small_game.bag_limits_vary: See official season calendar for species-specific limits

duck_limit_breakdown: Max 4 mallards (no more than 2 hen mallards)
waterfowl.stamp_requirement: Federal Migratory Bird Hunting and Conservation Stamp (Duck Stamp) required for hunters 16+

documents.title: Game Birds and Small Game Seasons

responsibilities: Enforce Maryland Criminal Law and Transportation Articles

game_wardens.jurisdiction: Enforce all fishing, hunting, trapping, harvesting laws in assigned areas

wma_regional_structure.description: Four regional divisions of Maryland WMAs

central_maryland.description: Near Baltimore and Washington. Tranquil and serene places within urban proximity

eastern_maryland.description: East of Chesapeake Bay. Diverse wildlife supporting kayaking, canoeing, hiking, bird-watching

southern_maryland.description: Largely unchanged since English colonial settlement 1600s. Appeals to hikers, hunters, photographers, anglers

western_maryland.description: Largest area with 120,000+ acres. Forested peaks/valleys of Blue Ridge and Allegheny Mountains. Canoeing, whitewater, hunting, fishing year-round
